lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a light-above-shadow-below intensity gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae individuals beneath the leading edge and ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
